Settings from your computer
Open Televim on your computer.
Go to Settings → Advanced → Transfer local data.
Choose “Transfer settings to Android”, create a QR code and scan it here.

In the system Files app, select a local JSON or .tgv file and choose Open with → Televim. For .tgv files, Share → Televim also works. For JSON, use Open with.\n\nCloud files are not supported. JSON files can be up to 2 MiB; encrypted .tgv files up to 8 MiB.
Local settings file
A local file is selected. Enter its export password if encrypted, then preview. A JSON settings file does not need a password.

Import settings

Paste the settings link copied from Televim on your computer.
Enter the separate password you chose when exporting on your computer.
